an6.42:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu carikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari
an6.42:1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an6.42:1.5: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an6.42:1.6: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
an6.42:1.7: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno …pe… buddho bhagavāti
an6.42:1.8: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ …pe… arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
an6.42:1.9: atha kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā.
an6.42:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an6.42:2.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi
an6.42:2.3: ke pana te nāgita uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭāmaññe macche vilopentīti.
an6.42:2.4: ete bhante icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantañceva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañcāti.
an6.42:2.5: māhaṃ nāgita yasena samāgamaṃ mā ca mayā yaso
an6.42:2.6: yo kho nāgita nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an6.42:2.7: so taṃ miḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyāti.
